lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca16La2Si2 (reduced formula Ca8LaSi) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows La and Si each adopt tetrahedral coordination with four Ca neighbors, while Ca centers display two distinct environments with four neighbors (one La and three Ca, or two La and two Si), with neighbor distances near 3.36–3.38 Å. Corner-sharing is observed between La tetrahedra and between Ca tetrahedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
